q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month, with unlimited notes and 3 devices. Annual billing saves you 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Team is $8 per user per month, so 5 people would be $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The free plan lets you keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, you can get a full refund. Since your Plus purchase was within 14 days, please contact support@example.com with your order number to request it.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Unfortunately, the refund window for Plus subscriptions is 14 days, and three weeks exceeds that period. You can still email support@example.com to discuss your situation with our team.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: No, there is no Linux desktop app. Linux users can use the web app instead.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No. Example Notes requires Android 12 or later.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs an internet connection. The mobile and desktop apps work offline and sync when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Don't worry! Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select your note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Non, SMS n'est pas pris en charge. Vous pouvez configurer l'authentification à deux facteurs avec une application d'authentification dans Paramètres > Sécurité.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The max attachment size on the free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No. You keep paid features until the end of your current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We typically reply within one business day. If you need help, email support@example.com.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: The Plus plan supports up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't have information about a student discount. I can open a support ticket for you to inquire about this—would you like me to do that?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't have information about importing from Evernote in our FAQ. I'd be happy to open a support ticket for you to get an answer from our team.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: We don't have that information. I can open a support ticket for you if you'd like—just let me know.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I'm here to help with Example Notes, and Python scripting falls outside my support scope. If you have questions about our note-taking app, I'm happy to assist!

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I can only answer questions about Example Notes. For weather information, you'll need to check a weather service. Is there anything I can help you with regarding our note-taking app?

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan includes shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: Plus and Team plans allow 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please email support@example.com with your order number to request the refund.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた方」ボタンをクリックしてください。30分間有効なパスワードリセットリンクをメールでお送りします。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I'm sorry to hear your notes were lost. Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days—open Trash and click "Restore" to recover them. If they're not there, please email support@example.com with details so we can investigate.
